project: Aron Terrace Apartment, 4898 El Camino Real, Los Altos CA (APN 170-03-085)
frame: viewer local frame: E,N metres from the revision origin (scene x = E, z = -N); polygon = where the building is in the Google Photorealistic mesh (unshifted); heights relative to the survey ground
generatedFrom: surveys/demolition/vestibule-evidence.json (polygonLotFrameUV_m, measured by surveys/demolition/vestibule.py) converted with the lot frame of alignment.json

polygons.name: Existing one-storey commercial building on the lot (demolished per the drawings)

designation.text: ALL EXISTING BUILDINGS, STRUCTURES, AND ON-SITE IMPROVEMENTS ARE PROPOSED TO BE REMOVED; limits of demolition = the lot

no building on the lot any more: BROKEN EDGE OF PAVEMENT outlines the cleared pad; the adjoining NEIGHBORING STRUCTURE (Lands of Baliweed LLC, APN 170-03-077, 0.2 ft clear) is outside the limits of demolition and is kept

polygons.method: Google mesh height above the survey terrain (top-down capture, 0.1 m): each face located by a half-height crossing (median of transects); see vestibule-evidence.json faces
polygons.confidence: designation: high (drawings + survey + imagery); faces +-0.15 m in the Google mesh frame

partyWall.why: the building abutted the neighbour along this edge; the neighbour wall behind it was never photographed

fill.what: cleared ground (graded soil pad), flat neutral colour, no texture (Esri imagery inside the pad shows the photo of the site, the Google texture is the old roof)

registration.what: Google mesh features minus survey positions, measured on 5 features (neighbour walls, ends, Esri pad); shifting the Google mesh by this vector aligns it to the survey frame. The survey frame (and the Revit model) is never moved.
